METHOD: a priori principles + intuition + deduction

stages.mechanism_strip: A shared demand for intelligibility produces different systems because independence, simplicity and individuation are interpreted differently.
stages.answer_line: Rationalism uses reason and innate structure to ground necessity while allowing experience to occasion cognition; shared method does not fix one substance theory.

stages.title: CARTESIAN METHODIC DOUBT, COGITO AND FIRST CERTAINTY

pills.text: CARTESIAN METHODIC DOUBT, COGITO AND FIRST CERTAINTY

I AM, I EXIST WHENEVER I THINK IMMEDIATE INTUITION

sequence: FOUR METHOD RULES: evidence → division → simple-to-complex order → complete review
SENSE ERROR → DREAM ARGUMENT → EVIL-GENIUS HYPOTHESIS suspend every belief that can be doubted
COGITO: I AM, I EXIST WHENEVER I THINK immediate intuition, not a syllogism
clear and distinct perception becomes the model
intuition supplies first principles; deduction orders consequences

stages.mechanism_strip: The attempt to doubt thinking existence performs the very thinking whose existence it tries to deny.
stages.answer_line: The cogito secures present thinking existence performatively, not an enduring immaterial substance, world or complete personal identity.

stages.title: CARTESIAN KNOWLEDGE ARCHITECTURE AND CIRCLE OBJECTION

pills.text: CARTESIAN KNOWLEDGE ARCHITECTURE AND CIRCLE OBJECTION
CAUSAL ADEQUACY OR TRADEMARK ROUTE + ONTOLOGICAL ROUTE; PRESENT
INTELLECT JUDGES EXTENDED, FLEXIBLE, CHANGEABLE IDENTITY BEYOND SENSORY QUALITIES

sequence: COGITO → IDEAS → GOD → NON-DECEPTION → MATHEMATICS AND EXTERNAL RES EXTENSA
IDEAS: innate / adventitious / factitious; objective reality = representational content
GOD: causal adequacy or trademark route + ontological route; present cautiously
WAX: intellect judges extended, flexible, changeable identity beyond sensory qualities
CIRCLE: clear/distinct premises prove God → God guarantees clear/distinct truth

groups.heading: DOCTRINE / CLAIM
items: COGITO → IDEAS → GOD → NON-DECEPTION → MATHEMATICS AND EXTERNAL RES EXTENSA
IDEAS: innate / adventitious / factitious; objective reality = representational content
GOD: causal adequacy or trademark route + ontological route; present cautiously

groups.heading: OBJECTION / PRESSURE
items: WAX: intellect judges extended, flexible, changeable identity beyond sensory qualities
CIRCLE: clear/distinct premises prove God → God guarantees clear/distinct truth
REPLY: present intuition compels; God secures memory and extended reasoning

groups.heading: REPLY / RESIDUAL
items: RESIDUAL: the divine proofs themselves use inferential premises
WORLD: involuntary sensory ideas require an active cause; veracity blocks deception
LIMIT: body-existence is stronger than exact resemblance of sensible qualities.

stages.mechanism_strip: Innate resources, divine veracity and involuntary sensory ideas rebuild knowledge and bodies, but Locke and the Cartesian Circle pressure the bridge.
stages.answer_line: God is the epistemic hinge of Cartesian reconstruction because divine non-deception extends clear and distinct certainty beyond the cogito, yet that hinge creates the Cartesian Circle.

stages.title: DESCARTES ON SUBSTANCE, INTERACTION AND FREEDOM

pills.text: DESCARTES ON SUBSTANCE, INTERACTION AND FREEDOM
ATTRIBUTE THOUGHT; MODES INCLUDE IDEAS AND VOLITIONS
ATTRIBUTE EXTENSION; MODES INCLUDE SHAPE AND MOTION
CLEAR CONCEPTION OF EACH WITHOUT THE OTHER

sequence: GOD = INFINITE SUBSTANCE, ABSOLUTELY INDEPENDENT
RES COGITANS: attribute thought; modes include ideas and volitions
RES EXTENSA: attribute extension; modes include shape and motion
REAL DISTINCTION: clear conception of each without the other
SUBSTANTIAL UNION: one embodied person experiences cross-domain coordination

groups.heading: SOURCE / DOCTRINE
items: GOD = INFINITE SUBSTANCE, ABSOLUTELY INDEPENDENT
RES COGITANS: attribute thought; modes include ideas and volitions
RES EXTENSA: attribute extension; modes include shape and motion
REAL DISTINCTION: clear conception of each without the other

groups.heading: ARGUMENT / MECHANISM
items: SUBSTANTIAL UNION: one embodied person experiences cross-domain coordination
OBJECTION: how can unextended mind cause extended motion? causal-closure pressure
REPLY: primitive notion of union; RESIDUAL: no transparent mechanism
OTHER MINDS: inferred through embodied behaviour, not given by the cogito

groups.heading: IMPLICATION / VERDICT
items: FREEDOM: will assents or withholds; error occurs when will outruns intellect
LIMIT: created substances depend continuously on God.

stages.mechanism_strip: Clear and distinct conceivability supports real distinction, while the human union is treated as a primitive lived fact rather than a third substance.
stages.answer_line: Cartesian dualism gains conceptual clarity by separating thought from extension, but its success in distinction becomes its central causal problem because heterogeneous substances must still explain one life.

stages.mechanism_strip: Because substance is conceived through itself and cannot be limited by another substance of the same nature, the system culminates in one infinite substance.
stages.answer_line: All modes are in God by immanent necessity, yet no finite mode or finite aggregate is numerically identical with the whole infinite divine essence.

stages.title: SPINOZA'S PARALLELISM AND ROUTE FROM BONDAGE TO FREEDOM

pills.text: SPINOZA'S PARALLELISM AND ROUTE FROM BONDAGE TO FREEDOM
NO CROSS-ATTRIBUTE CAUSAL TRANSFER; PARALLELISM REPLACES CARTESIAN INTERACTION
FINITE MODES ARE NECESSARILY CAUSED; CONTINGENCY RECORDS IGNORANCE OF

sequence: ONE EVENT → under THOUGHT: idea → under EXTENSION: body-state
ORDER AND CONNECTION OF IDEAS = ORDER AND CONNECTION OF THINGS
NO cross-attribute causal transfer; parallelism replaces Cartesian interaction
FINITE MODES are necessarily caused; contingency records ignorance of causes
CONATUS = each thing's striving to persevere in being

groups.heading: SOURCE / DOCTRINE
items: ONE EVENT → under THOUGHT: idea → under EXTENSION: body-state
ORDER AND CONNECTION OF IDEAS = ORDER AND CONNECTION OF THINGS
NO cross-attribute causal transfer; parallelism replaces Cartesian interaction

groups.heading: ARGUMENT / MECHANISM
items: FINITE MODES are necessarily caused; contingency records ignorance of causes
CONATUS = each thing's striving to persevere in being
INADEQUATE IDEAS + external causes → passive affects → BONDAGE

groups.heading: IMPLICATION / VERDICT
items: COMMON NOTIONS / REASON / INTUITION → ADEQUATE IDEAS → ACTIVITY
FREEDOM = acting from understood nature within necessity, not uncaused choice
LIMIT: autonomy survives, but alternative possibilities do not.

stages.mechanism_strip: The same modal event is expressed under Thought as an idea and under Extension as a body-state, eliminating cross-attribute causal transfer.
stages.answer_line: Spinoza reconciles freedom with determinism by treating freedom not as uncaused choice but as adequate self-determination within the necessary order of God or Nature.

stages.title: LEIBNIZ'S MONAD HIERARCHY, PERCEPTION AND INDIVIDUALITY

pills.text: LEIBNIZ'S MONAD HIERARCHY, PERCEPTION AND INDIVIDUALITY
WHY MONADS? EXTENSION IS DIVISIBLE; ULTIMATE SUBSTANCE MUST BE

sequence: WHY MONADS? extension is divisible; ultimate substance must be simple
GOD: necessary supreme monad / complete intelligence
RATIONAL SPIRITS: apperception + reason + moral agency
ANIMAL SOULS: memory + clearer perception
BARE MONADS: obscure petites perceptions

groups.heading: SOURCE / DOCTRINE
items: WHY MONADS? extension is divisible; ultimate substance must be simple
GOD: necessary supreme monad / complete intelligence

groups.heading: ARGUMENT / MECHANISM
items: ANIMAL SOULS: memory + clearer perception
BARE MONADS: obscure petites perceptions

groups.heading: IMPLICATION / VERDICT
items: APPETITION = internal transition; each perspective expresses the universe
IDENTITY OF INDISCERNIBLES secures uniqueness
BODIES = well-founded phenomena, not ultimate substances.

stages.mechanism_strip: Appetition moves each monad from one perception to another according to its own law, while its perspective differentiates it from every other monad.
stages.answer_line: Created monads perceive and appetitively unfold; minute perception differs from apperception, and God is their unique uncreated necessary source.

items: OBJECTION: programming/evil; REPLY: self-expression + optimal compossibility

stages.mechanism_strip: Truths of reason are necessary; truths of fact remain logically contingent through possible worlds despite complete-concept certainty in the actual world.
stages.answer_line: Leibniz preserves freedom by distinguishing certainty from absolute necessity: rational actions arise spontaneously from the agent's own reasons, which incline without necessitating in the logical sense.

stages.mechanism_strip: Each successor accepts the Cartesian pressure but redistributes substance and causation to avoid direct interaction between heterogeneous realities.
stages.answer_line: Spinoza removes the interaction gap by collapsing Cartesian substances into attributes of one order, while Leibniz restores plurality by replacing interaction with divinely coordinated internal activity.
